scientific_question: Can pair selection from a normalized consensus of the exact recorded training gradient and an independent fit-validation gradient preserve task direction across unseen validation tokens while retaining stable Frobenius angles?

identity.execution_commit_rule: record a clean pushed commit containing this immutable plan before implementation

shared_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in all arms

gradient_sources.recorded_train: optimizer probe gradient_after_clip from the exact dense Muon pre-step training batch
gradient_sources.fit_validation: average c_proj task gradient on fixed validation seed 20260804
gradient_sources.holdout_validation: average c_proj task gradient on fixed validation seed 20260805; scoring-only

arms.frobenius_output32: Existing Frobenius pair selector and simultaneous Frobenius residual-fit angles.
arms.fit_task_output32: Previously tested RMS-normalized residual-plus-fit-validation-gradient pair score with simultaneous Frobenius angles.
arms.consensus_task_output32: The same pair-score formula using G_consensus instead of fit gradient, followed by simultaneous Frobenius angles.

pair_score.task_term: v_ij = -(r_ij/max(q_ij,1e-30))*g_ij using the arm's task gradient
pair_score.normalization: divide u and v independently by strict-upper-triangle RMS, then add with unit weights
pair_score.candidate_graph: top 64 score neighbors per output vertex and deterministic compiled 32-stage edge coloring
pair_score.angles: ordinary simultaneous diagonal_metric_angles(S,R,pairs); task and activation metrics do not fit angles
